name: stream-machine
description: Run local streaming demos with Twitch, OBS, Stream Deck, and existing OpenDesign HTML workflows.

interface.longDescription: Desktop prototype with explicit Twitch title previews, local OBS alerts, a USB Stream Deck button, HTML creative workflows, and a separately started event worker. Requires local provider tools and private credential references.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Stream Machine and preview my first streaming recipe.
